messages.subject: simulate sex-specific detection parameters
parts:
Good day,
I'm trying to conduct some simulations.
I can simulate a population with two sexes, e.g.
>#
test.pop.sex = sim.popn(D = 0.015, core = syst.trap, buffer = 500, model2D = ("poisson"), buffertype = "rect", covariates = list(sex = c(M = 0.33, F = 0.67)))
#
but I'm not sure how to specify sex-specific detection parameters when generating simulated data using sim.capthist or run.scenarios.

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.

Eric

messages.author: dc98f54353beb59e
messages.subject: RE: simulate sex-specific detection parameters
parts:
HI Eric,

 

I think the sim.pop function is just simulating the locations of individuals. Rather, you might want to try one of the other simulation functions (e.g. ?sim.secr() or ?sim.capthist()) which will also (I think) generate capture histories according to a defined encounter model.

There are probably a few other ways that someone else can recommend as always is the case with these types of things.    

 

Chris

messages.author: 0a1292621f8e04de
messages.subject: Re: simulate sex-specific detection parameters
parts:
After looking at the documentation for rbind.capthist (and MS.capthist), I was able to generate simulated data under sex-specific densities and detection parameters two ways: sex as 2 sessions, and sex as an individual covariate.  Example code below.

############## Sex as session
#
test.pop.F = sim.popn(D = 0.010, core = syst.trap, buffer = 500, model2D = ("poisson"), buffertype = "rect")
test.pop.M = sim.popn(D = 0.005, core = syst.trap, buffer = 500, model2D = ("poisson"), buffertype = "rect")
#
test.chF = sim.capthist(syst.trap, test.pop.F, detectfn = 0, detectpar = list(g0 = 0.1, sigma = 300), noccasions = 8)
test.chM = sim.capthist(syst.trap, test.pop.M, detectfn = 0, detectpar = list(g0 = 0.15, sigma = 1500), noccasions = 8)
#
test.ch = MS.capthist(F = test.chF, M = test.chM)
#
test.fit = secr.fit (test.ch, model = list(g0~session, sigma~session), mask = rect.mask, CL = TRUE) # works
#
### end script
#
#
############### Sex as individual covariate
#
#
tpop.sexF = sim.popn(D = 0.010, core = syst.trap, buffer = 500, model2D = ("poisson"), buffertype = "rect",
 covariates = list(sex = c(F = 1.0, M = 0.0)))
tpop.sexM = sim.popn(D = 0.005, core = syst.trap, buffer = 500, model2D = ("poisson"), buffertype = "rect",
 covariates = list(sex = c(F = 0.0, M = 1.0)))
#
#
tch.F = sim.capthist(syst.trap, tpop.sexF, detectfn = 0, detectpar = list(g0 = 0.1, sigma = 300), noccasions = 8)
#
tch.M = sim.capthist(syst.trap, tpop.sexM, detectfn = 0, detectpar = list(g0 = 0.15, sigma = 1500), noccasions = 8)
#
tch = rbind.capthist(tch.F, tch.M)
#
tfit = secr.fit (tch, model = list(g0~sex, sigma~sex), mask = rect.mask, CL = TRUE)
#
### end script

Cheers,
Eric
